changelog: **Programme eligibility rules (#1945):** `ProgramEligibilityRule` (tenant model; effect ALLOW/DENY, allowlisted attribute or `attr:<key>`, operator EQUALS/IN/NOT_IN/GTE/LTE/EXISTS, priority, active) plus `Organization.eligibilityMode` and `Cohort.eligibilityMode` (`OPEN` default, `RULES` = ineligible by default). One evaluator in `src/lib/eligibilityRule.ts` (priority, DENY beats ALLOW at equal priority, deterministic), loaded by `src/lib/eligibility.ts`. Enforced server-side: `POST /api/mentorship` and `mentor-suggest` 403 `not_eligible` with the rule, the public apply form 403 before an account exists, SSO JIT provisions an unadmitted new mentee inactive + pendingApproval (`?error=sso_pending_approval`, `eligibility.denied`), match rounds drop ineligible mentees before scoring; invitation registration exempt. Builder at `/admin/cohorts/eligibility` with a live "who does this admit?" dry run (`/api/admin/eligibility/preview`, two queries). Docs `docs/program-eligibility.md`; tests `scripts/test/eligibility.test.mjs`, `e2e/program-eligibility.spec.ts` (@smoke).

en: Programmes can now have eligibility rules: decide by department, location or your own attributes who may be enrolled, see how many current participants a rule admits before saving, and have the rules enforced everywhere — assignment, applications, single sign-on and matching.
tr: Programlara artık uygunluk kuralları eklenebiliyor: departman, konum veya size özel alanlara göre kimin kaydedilebileceğine karar verin, kaydetmeden önce bir kuralın mevcut katılımcılardan kaçını kabul ettiğini görün; kurallar atama, başvuru, tek oturum açma ve eşleştirmede her yerde uygulanır.
de: Programme können jetzt Zulassungsregeln haben: Legen Sie nach Abteilung, Standort oder eigenen Attributen fest, wer aufgenommen werden darf, sehen Sie vor dem Speichern, wie viele aktuelle Teilnehmende eine Regel zulässt – durchgesetzt bei Zuordnung, Bewerbung, Single Sign-on und Matching.
